# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

## References

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).
- fa #1457 (five ghost cycles), fa #1520 (ghost #6).
- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).

- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

## References

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).
- fa #1457 (five ghost cycles), fa #1520 (ghost #6).
- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

## References

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).
- fa #1457 (five ghost cycles), fa #1520 (ghost #6).
- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).

- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +584
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).

- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +584
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. ## Capability surface

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +584
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

## References

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).
- fa #1457 (five ghost cycles), fa #1520 (ghost #6).
- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +584
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).

- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,

callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. - **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Deletions**: -13

- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

# gh-848: [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

## Subject

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). Live (fa, 2026-10-10, ghosts #4/#5/#6 AFTER the #843 cure-side fix went live): the tick dispatches validation on a PR head; a duplicate dispatch is cancelled by gh-748 within seconds; the duplicate's check-suite (registered at dispatch time, e.g. 21:40:01 — 12s after the 21:39:48 dispatch) is left `in_progress` with an unresolvable run link; mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED permanently. fa #1457 survived FIVE ghost cycles today (2h+ operator cost); fa #1520 seized the same way; every validated machine PR is at risk. Evidence chain: gh-842 comment thread (ghost #1..#6 timelines, check-run dumps, minter correction — the twin is a duplicate DISPATCH, fa CI is already dispatch-only).

## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
- Belt: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on the head; any still `in_progress`/`queued` gets concluded via the Checks API (requires the GitHub App token — PAT gets 403, verified) or a re-dispatch of a single-leg workflow that re-stamps the contexts.
- Audit: one marker comment per head noting the deferred/cleaned cancel.

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: replay ghost #5's exact timeline (dispatch 21:39:48, ghost 21:40:01) — no orphaned in_progress check-run remains on the head.
2. AC2: zero ghost-signature check-runs (in_progress + unresolvable run link) across a 24h soak on fa.
3. AC3: the twin-guard still prevents parallel validation waste (duplicate dispatches are still suppressed, just safely).
4. AC4: fa #1457-class PRs merge without operator resets once the fa pin carries the fix.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests — cancel deferred on queued; check-run cleanup after materialized cancel.
- L2: replay the real 21:39-21:41 timeline from fa check-run dumps (in gh-842).
- L3 (live): soak metric — ghost count on fa = 0/day.

## Non-goals

- The gh-843 cure side (detect/refresh/re-dispatch) — already shipped.
- Changing the dispatch-only CI topology — already in place on fa.

- gh-842 (full evidence archive, ghosts #1-#6).
- fa #1457 (five ghost cycles), fa #1520 (ghost #6).
- gh-755 (cancelled is never a verdict), gh-748 (twin-guard family).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 849
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/849
- **Title**: gh-848 [GOAL] MINTER fix: gh-748 cancels runs pre-materialization → orphaned in_progress check-runs seize the merge gate (ghosts #4-#6 on fa TODAY, after #843 cure went live)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-848` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +584
- **Deletions**: -13
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T23:53:21Z

## PR Description

Closes #848
### Root Cause

The gh-748 twin-guard cancel path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`) cancelled stale workflow runs while they were still `queued` (pre-materialization). A run's check-suite registers at dispatch time but jobs materialize later — GitHub only concludes a cancelled run's check-runs `cancelled` when jobs exist. A queued cancel therefore orphans the registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with the PAT), seizing mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED (live fa #1457 five ghost cycles, #1520; ghosts #4-#6 on 2026-10-10, after the gh-843 cure side went live).

### Fix

- `js/smAgent.js` — **guard**: before `gh run cancel`, poll `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>` until `status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) within `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs` (default 45s, poll 3s); still queued or probe-degenerate → **defer** the cancel to the next tick. Probe errors also defer — queue waste is always cheaper than a seized gate.
- `js/smAgent.js` — **belt**: after ANY cancel, list the cancelled run's check-runs on its head (`checkRunZombies.runIdOf` matching); any still pending is concluded `cancelled` via `PATCH /check-runs/<id>` under the GitHub App token swap (`silentToken` — the PAT gets 403, verified), mirroring `stampValidationChecksForModule`.
- `js/smAgent.js` + `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — **audit**: one marker comment per head per event (`⏸ ghost-guard defer …` / `🧹 ghost-guard clean …`), deduped against existing markers so a head queued across many ticks gets exactly one comment. Bookkeeping-only (gh-755 parity: `cancelled` is never a verdict).
- Supersedes the gh-846 same-tick cancel of *queued* runs — AC3 holds: duplicates are still suppressed, just safely.

### Test Coverage

- RED verified: the 4 new reproduction tests FAIL against the pre-fix code (queued run cancelled immediately, no belt, no audit).
- `test_smAgent.js` — 5 new/rewritten cases: defer on queued (ghost-window replay), cancel after materialization, belt concludes only the cancelled run's pending check-runs (App-token swap asserted), multi-run sweep (queued deferred + in_progress cancelled), audit dedupe per head.
- `test_validationLiveness.js` — 4 marker round-trip/parse/degeneracy cases.
- Full suite: **2504 passed, 0 failed**.

### Notes

- Tunables: `jobParams.cancelMaterializeTimeoutMs = 0` restores the legacy cancel-immediately escape hatch.
- Deferral cost: a superseded run may keep occupying the queue until its jobs materialize (one or more ticks) — accepted by design; the gh-842/843 cure-side sweep remains the general ghost backstop.

## Description

## Goal

The gh-748 twin-guard must never cancel a workflow run before its jobs have materialized — a cancel in the queued/pre-materialization window orphans the run's registered check-runs as `in_progress` ghosts forever (no run to re-run, no API to conclude them with a PAT), and the merge gate then holds on dead check-runs indefinitely.

js engine twin-guard cancel path (dmtools-agents). ## Capability surface

- Guard: before `gh run cancel`, poll the target until `run.status != 'queued'` (jobs materialized) with a short timeout; if still queued, DEFER the cancel to the next tick instead of cancelling (a live-materialized cancel marks check-runs `cancelled`, which is a clean terminal state).
